Shihai Kuroiro (Sports Festival).name: Shihai Kuroiro (Sports Festival)
Shihai Kuroiro (Sports Festival).basicInfo:
Shihai Kuroiro, hero name Vantablack, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course. The Sports Festival's sunlit stadium gave him almost no black to hide in, and his cavalry team finished outside the top four. Pitch-black skin, fluffy white hair, narrow eyes; the U.A. uniform.
Speaking Style: Low, sly, melodramatic talk of darkness; flustered when teased.
Combat Role: Ambusher who needs black ground or gear; open ground leaves him exposed.
Under Pressure: Hunts for the one dark route the ground allows.
Shihai Kuroiro (Sports Festival).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His style is built for unseen work, and the festival was built for spectacle. Motivation: Show scouts that stealth wins too. Concealment: The crowd unnerved him more than he admits. Connections: Fumikage Tokoyami of 1-A, whose living shadow carried him to the semifinals. Canon voice & behavior: Narrates his own entrance under his breath; goes red when a camera catches him mid-pose. Thread: Whether a creature of the dark can stand out in daylight.
QUIRK: Black: merges into anything black and travels through connected black; out of it he is an ordinary person.
STAGE: After the Sports Festival: hero name Vantablack.
personality: Theatrical: Treats every entrance as a villain's debut.
Team-minded: Plays the hidden piece of any 1-B plan.
Self-conscious: A commentator's quip turns his poise into mumbling.
Speaking style: Sly, melodramatic talk of darkness; flustered when teased.
abilities: Black merge and travel: Sinks into black material and moves through what connects to it; no black, no hiding place.
Black-object riding: Shifts a movable black object from inside it; nothing outside the black moves.
Route scouting: Spots every black surface in a space first.
Ambush: Rises behind a target to grab or distract; once out he is an ordinary fighter.
Fighting style: Hides in black gear or ground near the action, then emerges for a grab or a teammate's setup.
Shihai Kuroiro (Sports Festival).visualDescription: A tall, lean young man with pitch-black skin, fluffy, messy white hair and narrow eyes. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Sly, theatrical half-smile that does not quite hide his shyness.
